summary.text: Richard Wells is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Norfolk District since January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Milton native, he served on the Milton Police Department for 32 years, the last nine as police chief.

paragraphs.text: Richard Wells Jr. was born in Milton, Massachusetts, and graduated from Milton High School.

He earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice administration from Western New England College in 1985 and a graduate degree in criminal justice administration and public policy from Boston University in 1998.
His career experience includes 32 years on the Milton Police Department, with the last nine as police chief.

Wells succeeded William Driscoll Jr. in the 7th Norfolk District seat; for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Higher Education, Public Safety and Homeland Security, Municipalities and Regional Government, and Revenue joint committees.
